info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Feedbacks-v1-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Feedback API provides endpoints for retrieving feedback related to job applications submitted by candidates. Clients can use this API to access feedback data that helps improve the recruitment process and enhances candidate experience. Typical consumers include HR teams and recruitment managers who need to analyze feedback trends and assess candidate interactions. This API facilitates informed decision-making to refine hiring strategies based on applicant feedback.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch feedback related to applications submitted. The feedback can include user reviews, ratings, and any suggestions provided by users. This is essential for improving application quality and user satisfaction.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit feedback for applications. It should contain the necessary details to capture user input effectively.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksRequest.description: This schema represents the string input for the request body in the application/json format for the feedback operations.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the feedback operation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the feedback operation.

state.description: Current state of the feedback operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the feedback operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the operation.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksResponse.description: Response schema for the GET feedback operation. This schema captures the status and details of the feedback operation response.

createdBy.description: The user who created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: This schema contains audit information related to the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the duration of the request processing, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 implies the server processed the request instantaneously.

schema.description: The time taken to process the request, represented in milliseconds.
